title: Q-EXP-1a3d436e: close the existing-repo-adoption gap with a measured change
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every rnd pass
**Done check:** file:foundation/adopt.py
**Prediction:** pageviews_7d >= baseline within 336 h
**Status:** open

Experiment from R&D finding `gap:existing-repo-adoption`.
Hypothesis: 3 competitors evidence 'works on an existing repository or codebase'; building it should move the metric
Metric: pageviews_7d. Ship the smallest change the done check proves, then compare the metric against its baseline in doctrine/growth.json; a miss reverts the change and lowers the finding's priority.
